verified: Anthropic's formal-math GitHub repository hosts a paper titled “VP ≠ VNP over every field,” credited to Claude/Anthropic, alongside a Lean 4 formalization reported at roughly 73,000 lines; the repository describes the work as a research artifact Anthropic does not maintain and states that no human mathematician has checked the proof.
unconfirmed: The mathematical claim that VP ≠ VNP over every field has not been independently verified or peer-reviewed, and the paper itself says it has not analyzed how the argument relates to relativization or algebrization; it also remains unclear how much of the work was AI-generated beyond the “Claude” attribution.

verified: Anthropic 的 formal-math 仓库中确实存在一个 vp-vnp 目录，内含署名「Claude / Anthropic」、题为《VP ≠ VNP over every field》的论文以及 Lean 4 形式化代码；仓库自述该证明尚无人类数学家审阅，属于研究性产物，Anthropic 不予维护（据仓库本身及 AGI Hunt、lavx.hu 等报道）。论文本身也承认「尚未分析其与相对化、代数化的关系」。
unconfirmed: 证明的数学正确性，以及 Lean 形式化是否完整（有无 sorry、额外公理），均无独立验证；「Claude 为唯一作者」只是论文署名，尚无第三方核实其生成方式；论文篇幅（约 70 页）与形式化规模（约 7.3 万行 Lean）出自二手报道，不同来源表述不完全一致。
